mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 4.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains below 4.5% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 4.5% indicates tightening labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE falls below 4.5% but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of subsequent periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and consumer spending indicate robust aggregate demand, supporting corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both rise >1% monthly but S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in >50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL >2.5%) combined with federal funds rate above 5.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL >2.5% and FEDFUNDS >5.0% but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >55% of periods.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 110.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO falls below 110.0 but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in >50% of subsequent periods.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained non-farm payrolls growth above 150,000 per month signals strong labor market expansion, supporting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS remains above 150,000 for 3 months but S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in >50% of periods.

mechanism_narrative: Housing market recovery (HOUST >1300.0) combined with rising consumer spending (RSAFS >375,000) indicates accelerating demand, triggering positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: HOUST >1300.0 and RSAFS >375000.0 but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts above 1400.0 thousand units signals strong economic activity, driving immediate positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST exceeds 1400.0 but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in >60% of subsequent periods.
